resolution_notes: Verified against current MTA Bus Time developer docs (Index, Register, SIRI Stop Monitoring). base_url stays https://bustime.mta.info/api — SIRI paths are under /api/siri/... while OneBusAway discovery is under /api/where/..., so the API root is correct. free_tier_limits tightened to non-commercial free key + commercial approval when registration terms still say so. example curl kept with documented /api/siri/stop-monitoring.json shape; MonitoringRef/LineRef formats match wiki examples (MTA_ stop prefix, LineRef like MTA NYCT_M15).
free_tier_limits: Free with API key registration for non-commercial use; commercial use requires separate approval (per registration terms)
